# Documentation and Usage Guidelines {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Providing guidance on data interpretation, usage agreements, citation formats, and version management.
:::
:::

## User Guide {#guide}

- Users should read the codebook and data cleaning documentation before using the database.
- Users should distinguish between county-level statistical records and representative village-level surveys.
- Users should maintain the distinction between original values, standardized values, and estimated values.

## Data Use Agreement {#agreement}

- This database is primarily intended for academic research, teaching, and non-commercial purposes. Users should acknowledge the data source and cite the database according to the recommended citation format.

- Without authorization from the project team, users may not publicly distribute, resell, or use the complete database files for commercial purposes.

- Research outputs based on this database should clearly acknowledge the data source in academic papers, reports, or other publicly available materials.

- The database is continuously updated and improved. Users are welcome to contact the project team regarding potential errors, questions, or suggestions.

## Citation Guidelines {#citation}

::: {.note-box}
**Recommended citation format：**\
China Gazetteer Land Reform Database Project Team. *China Gazetteer Land Reform Database (Version 1.0)* [DB/OL]. Project website, 2026.
:::
